description:
ARVA: Agricultural Robustness across Varied Areas
	

This dataset accompanies the ARVA paper and provides the frozen
representations, split assignments, and result tables used in its empirical
evaluation. ARVA studies geographic transfer for Earth-observation foundation
models while varying target-region label access and holding the target test
examples fixed.
